query PendingPointULPLoyalty($accountId: String, $page: Int, $size: Int, $sortDirection: String) {
  pointPendingULPLoyalty(
    accountId: $accountId
    page: $page
    size: $size
    sortDirection: $sortDirection
  ) {
    code
    errors
    message
    serverTime
    data {
      content {
        orderDate
        orderId
        orderName
        point
        pointStatus
        notes
        __typename
      }
      empty
      first
      last
      number
      numberOfElements
      size
      totalElements
      totalPages
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
